digest.component_or_area: LLM model class resolution and provider qualification
propositions: A model id containing a colon in its version suffix (canonical Bedrock form like 'us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0') is misidentified as already provider-qualified and the configured provider='bedrock' is silently discarded

The decision to detect provider qualification was made independently in two functions (infer_provider and _resolve_target) using colon presence, causing them to drift and both fail on versioned Bedrock ids
An explicitly configured provider must be checked before scanning the model string for qualifiers, so no punctuation in the model id can overrule or discard it
A conflicting pair of configured provider and inline qualifier in the model string must raise an error rather than silently picking a winner
Unversioned Bedrock aliases like 'us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6' work by accident because they lack the colon that triggers the false positive
The error message reported a fragment of the model id as an unknown provider instead of naming the actual misconfiguration
